text: ニシキも　おまえさんの　こと　きにいってた　みたいやし　また　いってあげて！

structure.jp: おまえさんの　こと
きにいってた　みたいやし
structure.en: seems to have taken a liking, so

structure.jp: また　いってあげて！
structure.en: go visit him again (for his sake)!

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb says you do the thing as a favor for someone. The final て makes it a casual request. いってあげて = 'go there for him'.

patterns.name: 〜みたいだ
patterns.span: きにいってた　みたいや
patterns.explanation: みたいだ after a phrase says 'it looks like' or 'it seems'. Here だ is や, the Kansai dialect form. きにいってた　みたいや = 'he seemed to have taken a liking'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し at the end of a phrase gives it as a reason for what comes next, like 'and so'. みたいやし = 'it seems so, so...'.
